R&N_ITB,"80, 81",Design And Operational Requirements,Design Conditions & Requirements,Air Cooled Condenser,Air Cooled Condenser,,Air Cooled Condenser Air Cooled Condenser,"Air Cooled Condenser, Steam Turbine Exhaust Steam, Steam Turbine Bypass System, Supporting Calculations, Wind Direction, N+1 Fans, Condensate Extraction Pump, Vacuum Raising And Maintaining System, Steam Duct / Distribution System, Condensate Collection System, Condenser Air Removal System, Condenser Vacuum",Design Conditions Air Cooled Condenser supporting calculations wind direction predominant wind N+1 fans condenser vacuum condensate extraction pump vacuum raising system steam duct distribution condensate collection air removal,llm,Design Conditions Air Cooled Condenser supporting calculations wind direction predominant wind N+1 fans condenser vacuum condensate extraction pump vacuum raising system steam duct distribution condensate collection air removal,"The condenser shall be capable of condensing the whole of the steam exhaust from the steam turbine (including the bypass systems) under all conditions of load and operation. R&N_ITB,81,Design And Operational Requirements,Design Conditions & Requirements,Air Cooled Condenser,Air Cooled Condenser,,Air Cooled Condenser Air Cooled Condenser,"Steam Turbine Exhaust, LP Turbine Exhaust, Condenser, Turbine Bypass Dumps, Dispersion Headers, Demineralized Water, Water Chemistry, OEM Guidelines, Steam Ejectors, Mechanical Vacuum Pumps, Air Ejectors, Main Steam Supply, Silencer, Hotwell Tank, Condensate System, HEI Standards, Condenser Tube Leakage, Instrumentation",Air Cooled Condenser steam turbine exhaust LP turbine exhaust condenser turbine bypass dumps dispersion headers demineralized water water chemistry OEM guidelines steam ejectors mechanical vacuum pumps air ejectors main steam supply silencer hotwell tank condensate system HEI standards condenser tube leakage instrumentation,llm,Air Cooled Condenser steam turbine exhaust LP turbine exhaust condenser turbine bypass dumps dispersion headers demineralized water water chemistry OEM guidelines steam ejectors mechanical vacuum pumps air ejectors main steam supply silencer hotwell tank condensate system HEI standards condenser tube leakage instrumentation,"The steam turbine outlet connection pieces shall be designed for smooth transition with minimal obstructions from the LP turbine exhaust to the condenser to assure negligible pressure drop.

ACC OEM Design will take into consideration of proper material selection as per Demin water quality..
